note: Marks: love = blows my hair back, good = fine but not exciting, no = not for me. No notes were given.

sites.name: A Fianco
sites.why: White page with a stacked serif text menu, one short statement and a single black fig silhouette; very little on the page, but distinctive.

sites.name: Acacia Landscaping + Design
sites.why: Dusk garden photography with widely tracked caps. Atmospheric rather than brochure-like.

sites.name: Atera
sites.why: Full-screen footage of an ochre-walled thermal pool with only a small serif wordmark centred over it.

sites.name: Bakstad Construction
sites.why: A small Pacific Northwest builder presented with an architecture-studio level of typographic restraint.

sites.name: Barr Build
sites.why: A thin wordmark set over a meadow-and-timber-house photo. It sells craft through restraint and landscape.

sites.name: Bathhouse
sites.why: Low-lit teal pool photo with a monospace headline that switches to italic serif on one word; calm and slightly industrial.

sites.name: Bonnie's
sites.why: Bubblegum-pink page, a retro outlined wordmark with Chinese characters, and gritty flash photos of staff merch; playful and personal.

sites.name: BXR
sites.why: Low-lit cinematic interior footage, a tiny wordmark and a near-black palette give a boxing gym a members'-club feel.

sites.name: Castor Fleuriste
sites.why: Almost nothing but a centred serif name and corner labels on soft grey. Extreme Parisian restraint.

sites.name: Chambres d'Amis
sites.why: Oversized high-contrast serif split across the corners of a collage of food and light-and-shadow photos, like a magazine spread.

sites.name: Chillhouse
sites.why: Campaign video hero with chunky multicolour patterned lettering; the page is very loud. The homepage now leans toward its nail-product shop.

sites.name: COACHEDBY Club
sites.why: An edge-to-edge wordmark sits behind a team photo, with condensed all-caps headlines. It is a confident, poster-like personal-training brand.

sites.name: Core Atelier
sites.why: A large lowercase serif headline with italic emphasis over full-bleed interior photography. It reads like a boutique hotel, not a gym.

sites.name: Dash Burger
sites.why: Flash-lit photo of someone mid-bite cut off by a giant wordmark rising from a flat pink band; brash in a way that fits a smash-burger joint.

sites.name: Dimes
sites.why: Opens on a split grid of candid film-style photos above a salmon block of monospace nav tiles, so it reads like a zine rather than a restaurant template.

sites.name: do you read me?!
sites.why: A monospace product grid and an ink-blot logo make a Berlin magazine shop feel like a well-kept index.

sites.name: Double Dimanche
sites.why: Huge black grotesque words above and below one small framed photo of the lake; poster layout with lots of empty space.

sites.name: Elena Borisova
sites.why: A clinical psychologist's site with a large ink-brush bird drawing over jumbled oversized letters; personal and artful.

sites.name: Era Ceramics
sites.why: Oversized thin lowercase type laid over pale tableware photos, quiet and tactile.

sites.name: Field Studies Flora
sites.why: Opens on a grainy photo of a pinned specimen board. It is curatorial and museum-like, not 'pretty flowers'.

sites.name: Format
sites.why: A sparse white canvas with a lowercase wordmark and one neon-lime call-to-action tile.

sites.name: FreshCut Barbershop
sites.why: Split photo and red panel with a massive white condensed serif wordmark cutting across both; strong poster energy.

sites.name: Gimlet
sites.why: Cream card with a striped border, script wordmark and a fine-line drawing of the building; feels like a printed menu or invitation.

sites.name: Grand Street Dental
sites.why: Bauhaus-style half-circles in pink, orange and cobalt behind a bold serif 'Dentistry Redesigned'; cheerful without looking childish.

sites.name: Hart Bageri
sites.why: Full-bleed close-up video of dough being worked, a heavy condensed wordmark and tiny uppercase nav; very restrained.

sites.name: Haven Constructions
sites.why: A custom home builder with a saturated navy brand world and gallery-led storytelling.

sites.name: Hays Woodworking
sites.why: A deep oxblood field, hairline grid and an ornamental monogram give a millwork shop a crafted, heritage feel.

sites.name: HX Clinic
sites.why: Black-and-white silhouette photo, a thin-line monogram and a light serif headline in two weights; looks like a fashion brand.

sites.name: Integrated Podiatry Clinic
sites.why: Soft grey full-bleed photo of feet with a large light serif line and vertical side wordmark; calm and confident.

sites.name: Lamanna's Bakery
sites.why: Wall-to-wall 'HOME OF THE BIG SLICE' in fat yellow display type on orange. Pure neighbourhood bombast.

sites.name: Le Dive
sites.why: A red diamond tabac sign on warm paper texture with a serif tagline; one strong period idea, nothing else on the page.

sites.name: Librería Casa Bosques
sites.why: Asymmetric split layout of warm shop photography with a small spaced wordmark, like a magazine spread.

sites.name: Locomotion
sites.why: Strict black-and-white system, heavy wordmark and big card grid for class types. Disciplined and calm.

sites.name: Löyly
sites.why: Full-bleed aerial shot of the timber sauna terraces over the sea, a light spaced wordmark and an italic press quote.

sites.name: Maison Les Grands Chênes
sites.why: A big, airy grotesk title, mono micro-labels and long serif prose. A guesthouse that reads like a book.

sites.name: Marram Montauk
sites.why: Opens on an abstract sand-and-earth texture instead of a stock beach shot, with a small serif wordmark and a clay-coloured button.

sites.name: Minamishima
sites.why: Near-black textured page where one overhead plate shot and tiny spaced type do all the work, with a vertical Japanese seal for accent.

sites.name: Nine Zero One
sites.why: Photo of a terracotta-plastered salon with a neon hummingbird, set with wide-tracked small caps; carries the salon's mood rather than stock beauty shots.

sites.name: Odyssée
sites.why: Close-up skin portrait across the full screen, with the wordmark, a one-line promise and the nav set very small on a single line.

sites.name: One Manor Place
sites.why: A huge deep-green serif name, a monospace body and a warm portrait; reads like a magazine cover, not a dental practice.

sites.name: Persons of Interest
sites.why: A faded 1970s-postcard coastal photo with a tall condensed retro wordmark over it; looks nothing like a typical barbershop site.

sites.name: Pest Stop Boys
sites.why: A pest-control firm with a huge stacked wordmark on electric blue. It shows that a trade site can be loud and fun.

sites.name: Radiant Hot Yoga
sites.why: An all-terracotta palette with a hand-script tagline and chunky serif carries the 'hot' idea through the whole page.

sites.name: Rendezvous Barbers
sites.why: A big serif-with-italics statement on flat orange makes a barbershop feel like a magazine cover.

sites.name: Saipua
sites.why: Moody painterly still-life photography with a classic serif wordmark. Farmhouse romanticism done with restraint.

sites.name: Sebastian Cox
sites.why: Opens on three huge rust-coloured serif words (Buy, Commission, Collaborate) on near-black. Typographic and assured.

sites.name: Shinbu Aikido Club
sites.why: Floating pink and blue tiles with a kanji seal on a saturated blue field. A tiny dojo with a genuinely graphic, print-like site.

sites.name: Skulpt Fitness
sites.why: Huge black condensed headline on off-white with a single acid-lime accent. A small-town gym with a streetwear-grade identity.

sites.name: Sky Ting Yoga
sites.why: A spaced-out wordmark and calm studio photography, with tilted sticker-style elements that add wit without noise.

sites.name: Sóller Tennis Club
sites.why: Terracotta and olive colour fields and slow, story-led copy turn a local tennis and padel club into a lifestyle place.

sites.name: Studio Dental
sites.why: Full-bleed photo of the timber-slatted interior with a motion-blurred figure and a small serif wordmark; it sells the space and mood.

sites.name: Stykka
sites.why: Full-bleed photography of plywood kitchens in real homes, with tiny UI type letting the material speak.

sites.name: Tacaloa
sites.why: A teal-to-yellow sunset gradient behind a pill-shaped video window and a faded serif headline; unusual colour and shape choices.

sites.name: Terreno Barrio Hotel
sites.why: An oversized oxblood retro script logo over sunny street photography. Characterful and local.

sites.name: The Mind Room
sites.why: Mint, mustard and orange panels with brushy illustration and a tag cloud of topics; warm and approachable for a psychology practice.

sites.name: The Rechabite
sites.why: Black page with chunky display type in which illustrated characters and objects replace letters; a strong one-off identity for a multi-level venue.

sites.name: Thomas May Bespoke
sites.why: Charcoal vignette, small spaced serif caps and a vertical side menu. Joinery presented like a fashion house.

sites.name: Union Boulangerie
sites.why: Full-screen pastry video with a giant hand-drawn wordmark and flat electric-blue and orange nav blocks; loud but still about the food.

sites.name: Yinova
sites.why: Moody video of an amber apothecary bottle under a refined high-contrast serif wordmark and headline.
